reason: A dsh Web plugin that collects LLM request usage data and presents configurable sidebar metrics, model distributions, trends, and request details in a statistics panel.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh Web 中统计跨会话的模型请求用量，并通过可配置侧边栏组件和面板展示请求、Token、模型分布及趋势明细。
summaries.en: Tracks cross-session model request usage in dsh Web and presents configurable sidebar metrics plus panels for requests, tokens, model distribution, trends, and details.

capabilities: Reads session events and historical session logs to collect usage metrics
Aggregates and persists request statistics and display settings locally
Adds a configurable sidebar usage component and statistics panel
Exposes local HTTP endpoints for statistics data
